faq.q: How long until my order ships?
faq.a: Every piece is made or finished by hand after you order. Most orders ship within 3 to 5 business days, then take a few days in transit within the US.

faq.q: When should I order for the holidays?
faq.a: Order by December 12 for delivery before Christmas within the US. Orders placed after that are made as fast as we can, but we can't promise holiday delivery.
Shipping is a flat $5 per order within the US, and free on orders over $35. We don't ship outside the US yet.

faq.q: Can I send an order as a gift?
faq.a: Yes. At checkout, write your note in the gift message box and enter the recipient's shipping address. We'll include your message with the order.

On personalized items, type the name on the product page and pick your options. Use the maker's notes box at checkout for colors or anything else. We make it exactly as written, so please double-check spelling.

faq.q: What if something arrives damaged or wrong?
faq.a: Email us within 14 days of delivery with your order number and a photo and we'll make it right. Personalized pieces can't be returned for a change of mind, but we always fix our own mistakes.

faq.q: Do you make team or event orders?
faq.a: Yes. Nurse units, baby showers, book clubs, schools and small businesses order matching sets. Tell us what you need on the team orders page and we'll reply with a quote.
Payments are processed by Stripe on its secure checkout page. We never see or store your card number.
